items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: Not Frank? Eh? Frank? Not Frank?

ctx.x: The man that made the present, that clarinet, he was the... Oh, I keep getting... He was one of the hate men at the Werlein music place on Canal Street. Oh, Lord, what's his name?
Not Frank? Eh? Frank? Not Frank? No, he's got a French name.

No, he's got a French name. No, no. He's got a French name. Oh, Lord. It was a long time ago, though. Yes. About 30 years. A few things I was going to ask about. When you were a boy and started playing, how long did you practice when you first took up the instrument? Eight months. And how much each day did you... How long did you practice? I can't tell you that. I learned this morning. I can't tell you that. But I learned by instrument in eight months. In eight months you learned. Eight months. Did you practice…
